decisions.reason: The necessary Hero V impact is already fully represented by its message-197 MODIFY, including the vertical-only endpoint study, proportional 0–3% options, geometry invariants, and removal of superseded length-study attributes.

The necessary second-V impact is already fully represented by its message-197 MODIFY, including scale-relative measurement, the 0–3% height progression, geometry preservation, and removal of the obsolete right-arm-length rule.

The necessary accent impact is already represented by its message-197 MODIFY, which replaces the prior length adjustment with the selected proportional endpoint-height relationship while preserving the Option B terminal geometry.
The existing message-197 MODIFY already records that the original Option B terminal shape, taper, slope, and geometry remain locked while endpoint height is evaluated separately.
The source changes only the signature elements' endpoint-height study; it does not change the selected kerning, baseline, composition rhythm, or existing wordmark hierarchy rules.
The height-only adjustment applies to the Hero V, second V, and É accent and does not alter the construction, proportions, or architectural language required for the surrounding E and L letterforms.
The source makes no new material, finish, color-distribution, or champagne-gold decision; those treatment requirements remain unchanged.
The endpoint-height study operationalizes the existing quiet-elevation objective but does not revise the broader brand-expression values or positioning constraints.
Adjusting the signature elements' endpoint-height relationship does not change the decision to use a proprietary wordmark without a separate icon or monogram.
